verdict.rationale: dLocal documents outbound notifications sent to a merchant-specified URL on every payment status change, with a signature merchants can verify to confirm integrity. Webhooks can also be triggered in Sandbox for testing. So the signed-delivery core exists, but the remaining parts of the story are unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented automatic retry policy, webhook event/delivery logs, manual or programmatic replay of notifications, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
